text: This report recommends rental rate increases for meetings, conventions and exhibitions in all facilities within the Exhibition Place grounds for the period of 2026 to 2030. The recommendation is in response to increases in operating costs to maintain profitability and while keeping rates competitive with other venues.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved a market adjustment increase in rental rates for 2026 to 2030 inclusive, for meetings, conventions, events and exhibitions in all facilities across the grounds as outlined in Appendix A to the report (May 16, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place.
